name: Tokenory Counter
brief: A handheld mechanical tally counter for Tokenory, a local meter of AI token usage. An orange enamel casting frames three drums caught counting through 128. The complete front-facing instrument is tilted 7° counterclockwise. The window stays centred in the casting and parallel to its edges.

semantic_review.basis: Original project-specific illustration with custom mechanical numerals. There is no likeness target.

app_context.job_to_be_done: accumulate AI token usage and estimate its cost

style.style_notes: Precisely drawn physical instrument, warm enamel and graphite rolls.

icon_intent.metaphor: A mechanical counter, paused between two units.
icon_intent.small_size_readability: The key silhouette is the push button, case, and contrasting three-drum window.

canvas.alignment: Foreground layers use shared pre-rotation bounds, then rotate 7° counterclockwise around (512,512).

layers.shape_model: front-facing die-cast case with symmetric rounded corners
three broad drums in a recessed window
layers.fill: two graphite reels, one ivory reel
